title: Iran hit more U.S. military targets than reported — satellite imagery shows 228+ structures damaged
snippet: Imagery published by Iranian state-affiliated media and verified by The Post shows damage to at least 228 structures or pieces of equipment at U.S. military sites. Cross-checked against Copernicus data and archived commercial imagery.
tag_reason: 이전 14일 소스에 이란-미군 기지 위성피해분석 없음. WaPo 독자 위성영상 검증 OSINT — Copernicus 데이터 교차검증.

entities.name: 이란 공습 미군 기지 피해 228건 위성 검증 (WaPo/Copernicus)
